news.title: 'Biggest nightmare': Nithin Kamath warns MTF boom could worsen selloff in small and midcap stocks
news.summary: Zerodha co-founder Nithin Kamath warned that rapid growth in margin trading funding could amplify market downturns, especially in small- and mid-cap stocks. He cautioned that forced selling, liquidity constraints and rising leverage may intensify losses despite SEBI’s safeguards.

news.title: Pidilite Industries among 7 commodity stocks to hit 52-week highs and surge up to 25% in a month
news.summary: Six BSE Commodities Index stocks touched fresh 52-week highs as Sensex surged 972 points. Oriental Aromatics, Lloyds Metals, Tanfac Industries, Sudeep Pharma, Yasho Industries and Pidilite Industries gained on sustained buying interest, signalling strong investor confidence and bullish market moment

news.title: Market wrap: Jio Financial, HUL among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied over 1% as Sensex climbed 889 points and Nifty crossed 24,250, adding Rs 4 lakh crore in market value. Strong IIP data, optimism over FII inflows and gains in IT and metal stocks outweighed rising geopolitical tensions and oil prices.

news.title: Quote of the day by Lou Simpson: "One of the things I have learned over the years is how important management is in building or subtracting from value"
news.summary: Legendary investor Lou Simpson emphasised that management quality is central to long-term investing success. news.title: Dabur Q1 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 591 crore; revenue up 11%
news.summary: Dabur India reported a 15% rise in Q1 consolidated net profit to Rs 591 crore, driven by price hikes, cost efficiencies and broad-based FMCG growth. Revenue rose 11%, rural demand outpaced urban markets, while international business and premium brands delivered strong momentum.

news.title: Dhanlaxmi Bank Q1 profit more than doubles on lower provisions
news.summary: Dhanlaxmi Bank reported a more than twofold rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 24.9 crore, driven by higher income and lower provisions. Asset quality improved with gross NPAs declining to 1.8%, while operating profit increased 55% year-on-year despite sequential moderation.

news.summary: Bajaj Housing Finance Q1 Results: Bajaj Housing Finance on Wednesday reported a net profit of Rs 715 crore for the first quarter of FY27, marking a 23% year-on-year rise from the Rs 583 crore net profit reported in the corresponding quarter of FY27, with net interest income rising 9% YoY to Rs 968 c

news.title: Edelweiss Alternatives raises over Rs 1,200 crore for second Discovery fund; backs Arboreal Bio
news.summary: Edelweiss Alternatives Asset Advisors has secured over Rs 1,200 crore for its second Discovery Fund and made its first investment by leading a Rs 230-crore Series A round in Arboreal Bio Innovations to support manufacturing expansion and product development.

news.title: SBI raises Rs 4,691 crore via Tier 1 bonds at 7.75% coupon
news.summary: State Bank of India raised Rs 4,691 crore through Basel III-compliant Additional Tier 1 bonds at a 7.75% annual coupon. The issue received bids exceeding twice the base size, reflecting strong demand from institutional investors across multiple domestic financial segments.

news.summary: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee hit a three-week peak as local stocks surged, with traders adjusting their positions ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision. news.summary: Vedanta Oil & Gas posted a Rs 945 crore net profit for Q1 FY27. This marks a significant turnaround from the previous year's net loss. news.title: SML Mahindra to acquire Mahindra Truck and Bus division in commercial vehicle consolidation
news.summary: SML Mahindra will acquire Mahindra Truck and Bus Division from Mahindra & Mahindra through a slump sale in FY27. The deal consolidates truck and bus operations, expands its commercial vehicle portfolio, enhances scale, unlocks synergies and strengthens competitiveness across above-3.5 tonne segments

news.title: US stock market today: Wall Street futures inch higher ahead of Fed decision; Middle East tensions resurface
news.summary: US stock futures showed modest gains amid cautious investor sentiment ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy decision. S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose 0.2%, while Dow futures fell.

news.title: US Treasury yields rise as markets await Fed rate decision
news.summary: US Treasury yields ended a three-day decline amidst anticipation of the Federal Reserve's rate decision. Despite falling from July highs, yields are poised for significant monthly increases amid growing inflation concerns driven by higher oil prices.

news.title: US Fed Meeting LIVE: Hike or hold? Warsh keeps investors guessing ahead of Fed announcement
news.summary: US Fed Meeting LIVE: The Federal Reserve is expected to hold rates steady on Wednesday, but investors remain alert to a possible surprise hike.
